text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Despite her fierce desire to win, Fine 
Motion was defeated at the Queen Elizabeth 
II Cup. She expresses her unbridled 
frustration.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The yearning to win makes her experience 
the true joy of racing. However, that was 
an emotion she was never supposed to know.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Furthermore, Air Shakur confronted her 
with the harsh truth. That she only had 
one year left to race... That all the fun 
she had finally discovered would soon 
become just a memory.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Even after that, she continued to act 
cheerfully as usual. Yet a complex swirl 
of emotions could be seen in her profile. 
The end was drawing near... Next up is the 
Osaka Hai.
